recent.text: On November 19, 2018, Cal Petersen recorded his first career shutout in his third start with the @LAKings. Petersen made 29 saves, and Matt Luff scored his first career NHL goal, which proved to be the game-winner in a 2-0 win versus the St. Louis Blues. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/Ch8ttKCDmq
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 19, 2005, Pavol Demitra recorded his fourth career hat trick on free hat night at STAPLES Center. Demitra's three goals led the @LAKings to a 4-3 win over Colorado, and gave Demitra the team lead in scoring with 11 goals and 29 points in 21 games. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/xsoIl8GjOE
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 19, 1991, the @LAKings visited the Cow Palace for their first road game versus the San Jose Sharks. Luc Robitaille scored his team-leading 13th goal of the season, and Mike Donnelly scored his first career overtime goal in a 3-2 win for the #LAKings. #GoKingsGo https://t.co/fgzf8YhRoT
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 19, 1980, Jay Wells scored his first career goal, and rookie defenseman Larry Murphy had three assists in a 7-2 win over the Winnipeg Jets. The win placed the @LAKings in first place in the Wales Conference with a record of 13-5-1. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/MQKPFmKukm
